# hallpass_api_credential (Resource)

The credential HallPass adds to an API access profile's requests. The secret is encrypted in HallPass, never returned and never shown to agents. Give it as `secret` (kept in state, sensitive) or, with Terraform 1.11 or later, as write-only `secret_wo` (never stored in plan or state; for example from an ephemeral resource), sent when the credential is created and whenever `secret_wo_version` changes. Changing it applies to the next proxied request. Destroying it removes the credential: the profile's requests fail until a new one is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_api_credential" "github_read" {
  role_id = hallpass_api_access_profile.read.id
  type    = "bearer"
  secret  = var.github_read_token # a fine-grained token with read-only permissions
}

resource "hallpass_api_credential" "gcp" {
  role_id = hallpass_api_access_profile.gcp_read.id
  type    = "google_service_account"
  secret  = file("gcp-viewer-key.json")
}

# Terraform 1.11+: a write-only secret, e.g. from an ephemeral resource, never stored in plan or state.
# Bump secret_wo_version to send a rotated secret.
resource "hallpass_api_credential" "cloudflare" {
  role_id           = hallpass_api_access_profile.cloudflare_dns.id
  type              = "bearer"
  secret_wo         = ephemeral.onepassword_item.cloudflare.credential
  secret_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) API access profile ID (`rol_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `type` (String) `bearer` (`Authorization: Bearer <secret>`), `header` (`<header>: <secret>`), `basic` (HTTP Basic with `username`) or `google_service_account` (a service account key in JSON; HallPass sends short-lived access tokens).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `header` (String) Header name for type `header`, e.g. `X-Api-Key`.
- `scopes` (List of String) OAuth scopes for type `google_service_account` (default `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The token, password or service account key, kept in state. Exactly one of `secret` and `secret_wo` is required.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The token, password or service account key, write-only: never stored in plan or state. Needs `secret_wo_version`.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `secret_wo` again (Terraform cannot see changes of a write-only value).
- `username` (String) Username for type `basic`.

### Read-Only

- `hint` (String) The secret's last four characters, or the service account's email.
- `id` (String) The access profile ID (the credential has no ID of its own).
- `version` (Number) Increases with every change.
